description: This file contains implementation of classes and methods related to the NR PPA (Packet Protocol Adapter) protocol, including message encoding/decoding, handling of different procedure types, and JSON serialization, specifically for the nrppa protocol within the ASN.1 framework.

classes.name: nr_ppa_elem_procs_o
classes.description: Contains static methods and nested classes for handling procedure codes and message types in the NR PPA protocol.

classes.name: nr_ppa_pdu_c
classes.description: Represents the main PDU (Protocol Data Unit) for NR PPA, encapsulating initiating, successful, and unsuccessful messages.

classes.name: init_msg_s
classes.description: Represents an initiating message with procedure code, criticality, transaction ID, and message content.

classes.name: successful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents a successful outcome message with procedure code, criticality, transaction ID, and message content.

classes.name: unsuccessful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents an unsuccessful outcome message with procedure code, criticality, transaction ID, and message content.

methods.name: idx_to_proc_code
methods.description: Maps an index to a procedure code.

methods.name: is_proc_code_valid
methods.description: Checks if a procedure code is valid.

methods.name: get_init_msg
methods.description: Returns the initiating message type for a given procedure code.

methods.name: get_successful_outcome
methods.description: Returns the successful outcome type for a given procedure code.

methods.name: get_unsuccessful_outcome
methods.description: Returns the unsuccessful outcome type for a given procedure code.

methods.name: get_crit
methods.description: Returns the criticality for a given procedure code.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the message type (init, success, or failure) in the respective classes.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the message into a bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the message from a bit buffer.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the message to JSON format.

methods.name: load_info_obj
methods.description: Loads message info based on procedure code.
